g.text: I could not find an approved
An analyst asks a policy question with a precise time condition.
The router produces semantic and exact-match queries.
Search runs in parallel while catalog rules remove stale or restricted documents.
Forty eligible chunks move to semantic reranking.
The reranker promotes direct policy evidence above general guidance.
Only the five strongest passages enter the generation prompt.
The model drafts each claim beside its supporting passage.
A verifier checks that the cited text entails every material claim.
Supported claims become a concise answer with inspectable citations.
The analyst receives the answer and its evidence together.
A different question returns only weakly related evidence.
Generation may draft, but unsupported language cannot pass verification.
The verifier broadens retrieval instead of presenting a guess.
If evidence stays weak, the system abstains and offers a next step.
